en: A vintage postcard featuring a large Dutch tricolor flag (red, white, and blue) on a flagpole at the top. Below the flag is a framed black‑and‑white photograph of a substantial multi‑storey building with many windows and balconies, set in a grassy area with a person standing in front. The photo is bordered by ribbons in the Dutch national colors tied into bows at the corners. Decorative text beneath the image reads "Nijmegen" on the left and "Berg en Dal" on the right, with a small printer's mark and number in the lower left corner.
